basic_info.description:
This elegant four-story Art Deco home allows for the perfect lifestyle. Located in the heart of Potrero Hill, the residence features an abundance of large windows that fill its rooms, with amazing light.

The eat in kitchen is a highlight, featuring sleek quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances, making it ideal for preparing meals and entertaining. The home includes three spacious bedrooms, with antique tiger oak doors and generous storage. Newly refinished hardwoods and refreshed bathrooms offer modern fixtures with fresh paint and new lighting that complete the updated makeover.

There are two expansive living areas with beautiful hardwood floors and a few custom skylights, providing versatile and comfortable spaces. Enjoy coffee on the garden patio in the morning and unwind with a glass of wine on the upper deck in the evening, taking in panoramic city views and stunning west facing sunsets.

Additional features of the home include a large garage with a washer and dryer. The foyer is adorned with vintage hotel globes, adding a distinctive charm. 

Boasting a 97 walk score, this home combines luxury, extra space, and convenience, making it a standout choice just steps from the best that Potrero Hill has to offer.

Owner Splits water between tenants. Tenant pays all other utilities individually.
